facts.business: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited is an integrated alcoholic beverages company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of Extra Neutral Alcohol (ENA), proprietary Indian-Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) brands across whisky, rum, gin, vodka, brandy, and Ready-to-Drink (RTD) beverages.
